notes: WebGL2 fluid sim: RGB/YB pigment streams pour and flow into calligraphic 'ART' (SDF guide field), spectral subtractive mixing, glossy normals from paint thickness, drips, marbling, fade, click to re-pour. No console errors.
v1_issues: Streams puffed into flame/mushroom shapes; letters filled with blurry pastel gradients (per-channel max fill mixed all pigments); ragged pools under letters and stuck droplets; after marbling away a dim blue haze covered the whole screen; on mobile (portrait) too much paint for the small word — no letters formed.
v2_changes: Viscosity pass + elongated emitters (rope-like streams), weaker vorticity; fill only into emptier pixels (distinct marbled veins) + in-letter combing curl advection; thickened hairlines and T terminals so they fill; downward bias & medial-axis cleanup for stranded drops; strong final dissipation + coverage threshold (clean fade to black); speeds in screen-height units and sim grid by area (portrait layout works, word fits with italic overhang); two-light gloss, fresnel, studio-window reflection, meniscus darkening; adaptive pressure iterations; ?t= seek for previews; mobile toolbar resize ignored.
